items.docs:
View records of non-worked hours

**Permisos requeridos para utilizar este endpoint:** 
* Attendance permissions en: 'Lectura' o 'Lectura y Modificación'.

Allows to specify the number of hours of non-worked hours of a Colaborador in a given month.

An object of type NonWorkedHours must be sent as JSON in the body of the request, composed of:
- day: Day to determine to which period the non-worked hours belongs (optional)
- month: Month to which the non-worked hours correspond
- year: Year to which the non-worked hours correspond
- hours: Number of hours to add
- employee_id: ID of the Colaborador to which the hours are added
- type_id: Non-worked H
